svg.title: Verifying a landmark-relative certificate in Rust
svg.desc: The steps of verify_landmark_relative: split the certificate DER into TBSCertificate, algorithm and signatureValue; check both algorithm fields are id-alg-mtcProof; split the serial into log number and index; parse the MTCProof strictly; rebuild the MTCLogEntry from the TBSCertificate, replacing the public key by its algorithm and SHA-256; hash it as a leaf; evaluate the inclusion proof; compare with the trusted landmark subtree hash. The rebuilt entry matches the Python bytes exactly.

text.tspan: no signature verified; one SHA-256 chain from the certificate to a hash the browser holds.
